_doc: Single source for the generation lock: camera (Master Lock V3), locations (bible C + V4 §4), characters (V4 §2). tools/reflet.py reads it to build prompts for shots that have no verbatim Notion prompt. Edit here, not in the script.

camera.Lens Effects: subtle horizontal anamorphic streaks, gentle halation, mild blooming, restrained optical softness
camera.Depth of Field: medium, with focus behavior characteristic of a small-sensor DV camcorder
camera.Film Grain / Noise: subtle MiniDV digital sensor noise and restrained chroma noise, no added 35mm film grain

style.Artistic Medium: photorealistic cinematic DV footage still, disciplined in-camera realism
style.Cultural / Historical Influence: Paris contemporary story rendered with an early-2000s digital-video sensibility

forbidden: no VHS scanlines, no datestamp, no heavy glitch, no excessive noise, no video-game or spectacular CGI look, no invented readable lettering, no extra people

EXT-PARIS.setting: Paris riverside and buildings after rain, skyline above the Seine
EXT-PARIS.lighting: deep cobalt blue hour turning to night, warm amber windows and streetlights
EXT-PARIS.palette: deep navy, amber, graphite, muted cyan
EXT-PARIS.tone: cold blue with restrained warm highlights
EXT-PARIS.materials: wet stone, slate rooftops, river reflections

INT-BUREAU.setting: empty open-plan Paris office near midnight, one desk lamp and a computer screen
INT-BUREAU.lighting: cold monitor glow, a single warm desk lamp, dark windows on the city
INT-BUREAU.palette: graphite, monitor blue, warm desk amber
INT-BUREAU.tone: cold blue with restrained warm highlights
INT-BUREAU.materials: glass, laminate desk, fabric office chair

EXT-BUREAU.setting: glass office building entrance on a wet Paris street at midnight
EXT-BUREAU.lighting: sodium streetlights, cold lobby fluorescents spilling onto wet pavement
EXT-BUREAU.tone: cold blue with restrained warm highlights

EXT-ARRET-BUS.setting: Paris bus shelter after midnight, illuminated wet pavement, distant Eiffel Tower softly visible
EXT-ARRET-BUS.lighting: shelter backlight panel, streetlights, rain haze
EXT-ARRET-BUS.palette: navy, amber, wet graphite, muted cyan
EXT-ARRET-BUS.tone: cold blue with restrained warm highlights

LOC-01.setting: active Paris metro station exactly as the Notion « Metro » section (refs #34, #37, #39): smooth curved white vault, ONE continuous fluorescent light strip along the ceiling, arched alcoves on the far wall, cold blue fog, wet reflective platform floor, white-and-teal MF train with amber destination display, station Nation
LOC-01.lighting: continuous cold fluorescent strip, blue fog, horizontal blue anamorphic flares, soft dark vignette
LOC-01.palette: icy steel blue, teal, pale tile, wet graphite, tiny amber signage
LOC-01.materials: wet concrete, glazed tile, glass, painted steel

LOC-02.setting: empty late-night Paris metro carriage, same seat layout, grab bars, hanging grips, dark windows and line map as the master image
LOC-02.lighting: cold overhead fluorescent practicals, dark reflective windows
LOC-02.materials: reflective carriage glass, painted train metal, moulded seat plastic, rubber grips

LOC-03.setting: the SAME station architecture as LOC-01 (smooth curved vault, continuous light strip, arched alcoves) but abandoned for decades: strip half dead, mould, cracked tiles, peeling vintage posters, rusted benches, blank corroded station plate, half-open wooden door leaking amber at the far end
LOC-03.lighting: weak cold fluorescent spill and an isolated amber glow near the door
LOC-03.palette: mould green, aged ivory, rust, faint amber
LOC-03.materials: peeling poster paper, dust, rust, aged wood

LOC-04.setting: decayed Haussmannian hallway: damaged mouldings, crooked portraits, parquet, wrought-iron staircase
LOC-04.lighting: low-key amber practical lights with cold blue shadow edges
LOC-04.palette: dirty beige, tobacco brown, oxidized gold, cool shadow
LOC-04.materials: dusty oil paint, frames, cracked plaster, worn parquet

LOC-05.setting: dusty forgotten Paris bedroom, herringbone parquet, plaster mouldings, tall window, immense antique gilded trumeau mirror above a marble fireplace with a hairline crack
LOC-05.lighting: low, warm, unstable amber light contaminated by intrusive cold blue
LOC-05.palette: tarnished gold, walnut, unstable amber, cold blue
LOC-05.materials: tarnished glass, gilded wood, marble, dust

LOC-00.setting: narrow dark Paris side street leading to a Métropolitain entrance: wet cobbles, closed shutters, deep carriage doorways (portes cochères), one failing streetlight
LOC-00.lighting: one flickering sodium streetlight, cold blue spill from the metro entrance at the far end, deep black doorways
LOC-00.palette: sodium amber, wet graphite, cold blue, oxblood accent (the old woman's robe)
LOC-00.tone: cold blue with restrained warm highlights
LOC-00.materials: wet cobblestones, stone facades, iron shutters, rain

H.name: Héroïne
H.descriptor: the SAME young Black woman from the uploaded character sheet: voluminous curly dark hair, camel wool coat, dark crossbody bag
H.rule: strict continuity of face, hair and clothes across all shots

C.name: La créature
C.descriptor: the SAME hooded creature from the uploaded character sheet: worn pale robe and hood, altered gaunt face, red eyes
C.rule: never shown moving on screen in the carriage: it only changes position between cuts (jump-cuts, same axis); N01 full-body image = costume reference only: no blood on robe or carriage, no standing/walking pose

M.name: Jeune homme du passé
M.descriptor: the SAME young Black man from the uploaded character sheet: short afro hair, worn dark grey t-shirt
M.rule: flashback only (shots 29a, 29b, 30); never in the metro, no hood, no red eyes

N.name: Nouvelle passagère (blonde)
N.descriptor: the SAME young blonde woman from the uploaded character sheet: long wavy honey-blonde hair, fair freckled skin, light eyes, cream-white knit sweater
N.rule: DECIDED 31/10: blonde (Notion #24 + #82–88). Shots 36, 38. She is the one the creature devours at the end — stylised, no visible gore, lights cut at the impact

characters._doc: extra identity images: drop them in locked/ as H_extra_01.png, C_extra_01.png … (picked up automatically). 'element' = Arcads Element handle without @, once created in Arcads Studio.

V.name: La Vieille
V.descriptor: the SAME very old woman from the uploaded character sheet: long straight silver-white hair, deeply wrinkled pale skin, milky pale-blue eyes, layered tattered oxblood-burgundy shawls over a long rust-brown dress, long wooden-bead necklace, bony hands with long yellowed nails and stone rings
V.rule: dark street only (06a, 06b; absent in 06d): motionless in the doorway, speaks ONE line to the heroine with lip sync in 06b, never touches her, vanishes when the heroine turns back; same hair, robe, necklace and rings every frame; no gore
